narrative.summary: This contract was USDe’s minter until 2024-07-08 and has been inert since: USDe.mint() called from it reverts, and it holds no collateral. Its owner is the 5-of-10 Safe directly, with no delay, which is what its on-chain entry still reads (55/100/0, composite 52, last written by the 2026-09-19 push).
narrative.tag: retired 2026-09-20, stale historical reading, no longer refreshed
narrative.detail: Found by the unscored-role sweep: USDe.minter() has pointed at a different EthenaMinting (the idx 14 card, USDe live minter) since block 20261016, and re-pointing it here would need USDe.setMinter, which sits behind the 24h timelock. The oracle has no removal function, so this target is retired by ceasing to refresh it: the 2026-09-20 push wrote the live minter as index 14 (Ethereum L1 now tracks 15 targets, 14 of them refreshed) and left index 3 untouched. Its on-chain entry stays as a historical reading and turns stale nine days after its last update, which was the 2026-09-19 push. The old number was right about this contract and irrelevant to USDe.
